author: starter-kit
hypothesis: Warmup-trained stage scores (p_apply x p_screen x p_decision) x fee_if_decided_yen are the reference baseline; a participant method should beat it on macro_daily_replay_fee_yen.
conclusion: Evaluator trial run complete: the baseline (and every submission) scores macro_daily_replay_fee_yen = 0.0 because the 3 proof evaluation days contain zero kettei_dt events in both the base and replayed markets; only the counterfactual diagnostic is positive (4898.55 JPY/day). The proof dataset therefore cannot rank participants on the primary metric; see output/summary.md for decision-density, seed-variance, timing observations and four bugs reported without fixing.

data_version.note: Actual regenerated manifest differs from the documented hash because manifest.json embeds nondeterministic generation_seconds (bug 1).

config.extraction_strategy: warmup-balanced refit from observed warmup referrals only; 322807 warmup events (seed71) / 319776 (seed72); 3 stage models fit on 616/68/18 balanced rows (positives 308/34/9) for seed71; no latent columns used
config.ranking_rule_definition: p_decision_baseline = clip(p_apply,1e-9,1-1e-9) * clip(p_screen,1e-9,1-1e-9) * clip(p_decision,1e-9,1-1e-9); order by p_decision_baseline * fee_if_decided_yen descending, ties by (day_dt,user_id,item_id) ascending

production_reference.note: Production-size config; generated by organisers later.

seed_variance.note: Primary metric is degenerate (0.0 for both seeds), not low-variance.

generate_dataset_internal.scope: manifest.generation_seconds = simulate + warmup training + write (no separate breakdown)

build_baseline_wall.scope: includes uv startup; no internal stage breakdown

bugs_found_not_fixed: manifest.json embeds nondeterministic generation_seconds so the manifest-hash data version changes on every regeneration (market_export.py:202)
zero kettei_dt in the 3 evaluation days makes macro_daily_replay_fee_yen identically 0 for all submissions and replay_positive_capture null (base_decided=0)
organiser DB lacks the candidate-recipe indexes added only to the participant copy; candidate_rows(latent=True) there takes >17 min CPU vs 0.78 s via the fast equivalent path
replay skips 503/752 (seed71) and 560/905 (seed72) selected pairs as no_seeker/seen, shrinking effective introductions (candidate recipe vs replay live_s/seen semantics need investigation)
